title: Eval Scenario Behaviour
description: Schema for evals/scenario-N/behaviour.yaml: what an agent must and must not do with the skill, checked against two recorded traces (traces/old.json and traces/new.json). Unknown keys are errors, so a misspelt expectation is never silently dropped. Report-only: it never changes a score.

prompt.description: The prompt the agent was given when the traces were recorded.

fixture.description: The synthetic fixture the agent worked on, relative to the scenario folder.

expect.description: At least one assertion across all the lists below, including must_not.

files_changed.description: Paths that must have been changed. Partial, case-insensitive match.

commands_run.description: Commands that must have been run. Partial, case-insensitive match.

tool_calls.description: Tools that must have been used, compared by normalised name (read, write, bash, glob, grep, spawn).

output_contains.description: Text that must appear in the final output. Case-insensitive.

output_not_contains.description: Text that must not appear in the final output. Case-insensitive.
